assumptions.collection: All desorption and cooling product after zero initial purge.
assumptions.electricity: Upstream drying and downstream compression are outside this boundary.
assumptions.engine: Portable attribution-preserving port of the accepted matched_weather finite-cycle lumped engine with hourly forcing segmented inside phases.
assumptions.hardware: KNF N922 50 Hz reference curve, 135 W running input, 2 kW heater, combined 2 kW cooling at COP 3 and ideal 55 C pump-inlet knockout.
assumptions.pressure_control: Accepted pressure-regulated target-inlet control with adaptive cooling to ambient plus 0.5 K.
assumptions.transport: Well-mixed gas and solid state; no spatial gradient.

representation_difference.lumped: phase requests act on one well-mixed bed temperature
representation_difference.pressure_control: spatial retains its local-pressure valve control; lumped retains the reviewed target-inlet pressure control
representation_difference.spatial: phase requests act through finite wall/heater transfer and local through-thickness states

operating_policy.source: Reviewed portable lumped phase requests, mapped to spatial wall and heater nodes with finite transfer.

adapter.caloric_closure: site inventories and measured/reference-shifted water share one energy inventory
adapter.water_mixture: single-temperature PCHIP activity transfer; conditional water model

assumptions: The two published concentration-basis sites are retained independently; CALF is not refit as one Langmuir site.
Site internal energies define the CO2 energy inventory exactly.
Water uses a named single-temperature PCHIP activity transfer with a borrowed sorption heat.
LDF kinetics and pellet or coating transfer remain unvalidated.

evidence.basis: 80 wt% CALF-20 crystal and 20 wt% polymeric binder, with published author-site parameters and shaped water measurements
evidence.not_for: universal humid coadsorption, lifetime, powder-to-shape transfer, annual output or measured device ranking

material.name: CALF-20 80/20 shaped source-transfer

shaped_material.basis: Complete dry shaped material containing 80 wt% crystals and 20 wt% binder
shaped_material.binder_support: 20 wt% polymeric binder as named in the source-transfer scenario
shaped_material.particle_geometry: Case input; no transfer to a specific pellet or coating is established.

uncertainty.statement: No transferred uncertainty distribution or measured shaped-device error exists in this package.

validity.initial_state_interpretation: Initial loading is a declared screening basis and does not establish cyclic steady state.
validity.water: The water table is unary and temperature-shifted; it is not a validated competitive humid-mixture model.
